name: Missouri
source: gun-policy Season 3 Stage 5, Missouri pilot (MISSOURI-PILOT-REPORT.md and write/mo-01/recipe.json), 2026-11-12
sessions: A session each year. Special sessions carry ids like MO-HB-16-SP1-2020.

votes.floor_rule: LegiScan's Missouri roll-call text does not name the motion: match each vote to a bill-history action by date and tally.
gaps: Most Senate roll calls are missing from LegiScan's data: Senate seats rest on House records, sponsorships or own words.

texts.marks: Bill texts are PDFs. Bold words are new; words in bold brackets are struck.
texts.note: Missouri re-files the same bill every year: expect many copies in the sponsor cover (277 bills before the re-file trim, 176 after).

search_note: Missouri sponsorships and House floor votes on this topic come from the bulk bill data (listed above): skip the legislature's sponsor lists and vote pages, and add the place "sponsor list: covered by bulk bill data". Spend the search on their own words (statements, campaign pages, newsletters, floor remarks, interviews, questionnaires). If any page returns 403, an empty page or a bot check, record it as blocked and move on: do not retry it with a different user agent, headers or tool.
bill_table_note:
- Missouri bill text is a PDF: bold words are new law, words in bold brackets are struck. `operative_text` quotes the law as the bill leaves it.
- Most Senate roll calls are not on file, so a bill may show House votes only.
quirks: LegiScan spells some legislators another way: check every new idmap.tsv line against the person's name and chamber (6 fixed in 2026-11).

The shared fill quote checker (check_fill_quotes.py) has not been run on Missouri's PDF texts: its 2026-11 check also removed page headers and line numbers from the PDF text. Add those as text clean-up before relying on it here.
